# Running the business {#sec-blp-management}

> *Assessment objective 2: the management of a business and company decision making to ensure
> compliance with statutory and other legal requirements.*

::: {.callout-note title="Not yet written"}
Outline below. Drafted to the same depth as @sec-blp-vehicles.
:::

## Planned contents

**Directors** — types (de jure, de facto, shadow); appointment; removal under s.168 CA 2006 and the
special notice procedure; the *Bushell v Faith* clause; disqualification.

**Directors' duties** — ss.171–177 CA 2006 taken one at a time, with the consequences of breach and
ratification under s.239. The duty to promote the success of the company (s.172) and the conflict
duties (ss.175–177) carry the most exam weight.

**Transactions requiring member approval** — substantial property transactions (s.190), loans to
directors (s.197), long-term service contracts (s.188), payments for loss of office (s.217).

**Company decision making** — board meetings versus general meetings; notice, quorum and voting;
ordinary and special resolutions; written resolutions and why public companies cannot use them;
general meetings requisitioned by members (s.303).

**Filing and record keeping** — confirmation statement, annual accounts, statutory registers, the
PSC register, and the consequences of default.

**Partnership decision making** — the s.24(8) majority/unanimity split and actual versus apparent
authority under s.5 PA 1890, cross-referenced from @sec-blp-vehicles.

**Conduct** — the solicitor advising a board; who the client is when directors and shareholders
disagree; and the limits of taking instructions from one director.
